Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Gaurav Kumar Chand
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,Acting Chief Justice
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

On 21.12.2023, the following order was passed:
"1.
The land of the petitioners was taken in the year 2005 without any formal acquisition for construction of a railway line.
However, compensation has not been paid to the petitioners, so far.

2. The Railways and the State-respondents have furnished instructions to their Lakhan Lal And 5 Others vs Union Of India And 4 Others on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15888237/
1 respective counsel.

entities.text: Lakhan Lal And 5 Others vs Union Of India And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Both the set of instructions are taken on record.

A perusal thereof,
reveals that the Railways and the State-respondents are shifting burden on each other for delay in not paying the compensation amount.
The petitioners who have been deprived of their land without any formal acquisition are not concerned with the inter se dispute between the Railways and the State-respondents.

3. We direct respondent Nos. 3 to 5 to hold a joint meeting and resolve the issue and ensure that compensation amount is determined and paid to the petitioners within two weeks, failing which this Court would be compelled to fasten personal liability on the officers found responsible for the delay.

4. List as fresh on 11.01.2024.
5.

Shri S.P. Singh, learned Additional Solicitor General of India appearing for respondent Nos. 1 and 4 and Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents shall communicate the instant order to the concerned respondents for immediate compliance."

2. An affidavit has been filed by Deputy Chief Engineer, Construction-I, Jhansi, North Central Railway stating that a joint meeting was held on 27.12.2023 in which compensation amount has been determined.
It is a sum of Rs.32,49,920/- and financial approval thereof is being obtained and payment will be made within two weeks.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners fairly states that, in case, the compensation amount is released as undertaken, the petitioners would be left with no grievance.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with direction to the respondents to ensure payment of compensation amount to the petitioners within two weeks from today.
5. All applications stands disposed of accordingly.

(Kshitij Shailendra, J) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, A.C.J.) Order Date :- 11.1.2024 Ankit.
